newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei closes at low for the year.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei closes at low for the year.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index closed at a low for the year on Thursday, brokers said, as selling in cash stocks and futures escalated shortly before the close.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 tumbled 522.36 points, the third largest one-day drop this year, or 2.60 percent to settle at 19,570.67. Its March futures plunged 460 points lower to land at 19,660.
"Buyers disappeared late in the session, especially after bargain-hunting of Nikkei 225 futures failed to emerge," Akishige Ishikura, Dai-ichi Securities analyst, said.
"After that, arbitrage-linked selling gained momentum dragging cash stocks down with it," he said.
Decliners overwhelmed advancers, 1,089 to 93, while 69 issues were unchanged.
